newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Changchai to omit B share dividend.
newsitem.headline: Changchai to omit B share dividend.

text.p: Diesel engine maker Changchai Co Ltd said on Thursday it had gained approval from shareholders to waive a dividend payment for holders of B shares based on 1996 results.

But Changchai will issue an after-tax cash dividend of 0.288 yuan per A share based on profits made in the January-August period of 1996, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The decision was made because the company listed its 100 million foreign currency B shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange only in September 1996, brokers said.
Profits for both A and B shares for the September-December period in 1996 amounted to 43.75 million yuan, which will be distributed along with the company's 1997 dividend, the statement said.
Changchai, based in Changzhou city in eastern Jiangsu province, posted net profits of 230.7 million yuan for 1996 against 203.1 million yuan for 1995 under international accounting standards.
